staleMarineMutators.note: Marine mutator on a tile that is not coastal by real adjacency - the classic survivor of a repaint.

waterBiomeOnRaisedLand.note: Ocean or SeaIce biome with elevation > 0. Lake is EXCLUDED - a lake at altitude is ordinary geography, and including it made this check fire once per authored lake.

lakesAboveSeaLevel.note: INFORMATIONAL, scores ZERO. Lake tiles above sea level, which is normal. Here so a genuinely suspicious count is still visible.

singleTileIslands.note: Land tile with every neighbour water.

riverSystems.note: Only TRUNK systems (HugeRiver/LargeRiver) are defects. Low-accumulation rivers are ALLOWED to die in playas and salt pans - owner's ruling.

lushBiomesOffRiver.note: Nile-style ruling: a 1-2 tile lush band follows EVERY river. Lush terrain away from one is the defect.
